name: Stay On Target!
author: myibookmoe
description: Hi, this is myibookmoe with my latest entry for the LEGO Ideas Build your own Game contest, Stay On Target! Destroy the fearsome battle station of the dreaded Lolwhut Empire and save the galaxy! Shoot all the turrets (or just avoid them) and shoot the big red and yellow thing at the end to win! A and D moves your ship left and right, W turns on boost, S turns on reverse thrust and spacebar shoots. Good luck! Thanks to Rasmus Harr (@rasmush19) for his kind assistance!
